original_main_reproduction.note: Same signed inputs; time limits/concurrency can change a budgeted incumbent. Differences are reported, never forced away.

reorder_convergence_diagnostic.note: Best-improvement from the common seed can reach a different local minimum than the main first-improvement order. It need not dominate that main reorder result. This post-hoc graph diagnosis does not change the predeclared primary comparison.

limits: Independent export/DP/oracle-cost and sampled rotated-geometry audit; not independently solved IK/A*, continuous collision, contact force or measured execution. Minima are regional finite-pool certificates. Deterministic nine-case grid does not establish a population confidence interval, global optimality or generic superiority.
